title: Highly emissive dibenzofuranfluorophores with aggregation-induced emission for bioimaging in HeLa cell lines
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35253-35264
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05626H, Paper
Open Access

Nikita Kush Durgi, Prasad Pralhad Pujar
Two novel dibenzo[b,d]furan-based organic fluorophores have been synthesized. Their cytotoxicity and bioimaging applications in HeLa cells have been discussed.
